Notes: Turner5754 gives Darrai and Wegal tatī father in the tāta family, alongside tat/tata father forms elsewhere. The source Darrai tātā belongs to this kinship-address family; retain its final ā rather than copying the comparator’s ī. The historical entry includes affectionate address to both younger and older relatives, not only the modern father sense. Source dar lect and unmarked/marked lengths preserved; the source supplies no page locator. Pashai parental kinship, retaining nursery-word and dialect caveats; no rebuild.

This is the dādda kinship family, retaining the exact Darrai sense and dialect rather than importing another dialect’s relationship label. Source dar lect and unmarked/marked lengths preserved; the source supplies no page locator. Pashai parental kinship, retaining nursery-word and dialect caveats; no rebuild.
